name: straddle back lever
description: A back lever hold with both legs straight and spread wide. It is the last step before the full back lever.
instructions: Get into an advanced tuck back lever.
Extend both legs out wide into a V while keeping your hips straight.
Hold your whole body level with the floor.
Keep your arms locked and your glutes tight so your lower back does not sag.
Hold, then tuck back in and exit with control.
